ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: After ignoring the curved arrows in the figure, it is a static molecular structure: the upper part is a nitrogen-containing six-membered ring, and the nitrogen atom in the ring is connected downward to a substituted benzene ring; this benzene ring bears two nitro substituents. The saturated carbon on the right side of the upper six-membered ring is connected to an external amino group, and the amino group is connected to H and an unknown R substituent. Reasoning: According to the specified writing, start from the unknown R substituent as a wildcard to obtain *N; this nitrogen is connected to the saturated carbon of the upper heterocycle, and the six-membered ring is written as C1C=CC=CN1; the ring nitrogen is then connected to the lower benzene ring bearing two nitro groups, written as c1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc1[N+](=O)[O-]. Combining gives the target SMILES.

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a static molecular graph and discard all curved arrows. Start the SMILES at the unknown R substituent as wildcard * attached to the exocyclic amine nitrogen: *N. Attach that N to the saturated carbon of the top heterocycle and write the six-membered ring as C1C=CC=CN1, with the ring N carrying the aryl substituent. Then append the N-linked lower phenyl ring as c1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc1[N+](=O)[O-], placing the two nitro groups at the positions shown. Combining these gives *NC1C=CC=CN1c1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc1[N+](=O)[O-].
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中忽略弯箭头后，是一个静态分子结构：上方为含氮六元环，环内氮原子向下连接到一个取代苯环；该苯环带有两个硝基取代基。上方六元环右侧的饱和碳连接一个外侧胺基，胺基上连有 H 和未知 R 取代基。推理：按指定写法，从未知 R 取代基作为通配符开始，得到 *N；该氮连接到上方杂环的饱和碳，六元环写作 C1C=CC=CN1；环氮再连接下方带两个硝基的苯环，写作 c1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc1[N+](=O)[O-]。合并得到目标 SMILES。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the drawing as a static transition-state connectivity diagram while ignoring curved arrows: a six-membered pyridine-derived ring at the top has its ring N bonded downward to a dinitrophenyl ring, and the adjacent ring carbon is bonded to an exocyclic -NH-R group. The lower benzene ring bears two nitro substituents, one ortho and one para to the N-linked position.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the task is to choose/write the SMILES for the shown transition-state structure and explicitly ignore the arrows.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions for a partially saturated pyridine ring with the attacked carbon written as aliphatic C, encode the exocyclic R group as wildcard * attached to N, encode nitro groups as [N+](=O)[O-], and encode the lower nitro-substituted phenyl ring aromatically.
